paragraphs.text:
If you succeeded, you hear the slinky sound or smell the reptilian 
odor of asps. They are slithering on the floor. Two seem to be 
under the bedclothes! In moments they’ll be at your head. 
If you stay where you are, you will automatically die. To pull 
the emergency cord, go to 427. To leap out the window, go to 
151. To jump to the door of your room, go to 152.
(93)
